name: Burnout
description: Pattern related to chronic stress fatigue, energy depletion, and feeling emotionally drained.
safetyGuidance: This is not a clinical diagnosis. Pattern match based on sustained stress and energy depletion.

solutions.title: Guided Breathing
instructions: Lie back or lean back in a comfortable chair.
Inhale deeply expanding your abdomen for 4 seconds.
Exhale slowly letting all muscular tension go for 6 seconds.

solutions.title: Short Meditation
instructions: Close your eyes and release any goal or expectation.
Allow your body to rest completely.
Remember that rest is an essential necessity, not something to earn.

solutions.title: Rest / Reset Activity
instructions: Step completely away from work, screens, and responsibilities for 10 minutes.
Sip a warm drink, look out a window, or close your eyes.
Do not consume media or process tasks during this window.

solutions.title: Gentle Movement / Walk
instructions: Take a slow 10-minute stretch or light stroll.
Move without urgency or fitness goals.
Focus on releasing physical stiffness in your spine and neck.

solutions.title: Daily Load Prioritization
solutions.purpose: Help the user identify essential tasks and avoid attempting to complete everything simultaneously.
